days.highlight: 凌晨约00:20在瓦纳卡求婚成功，直升机已完成，约18:00—19:30已完成徒步。晚上自行观星，不参加 Big Sky 观星团；21:30—23:00仅沿用原计划窗口，具体出发和返回未确定。
days.highlightEn: A successful proposal in Wānaka around 00:20, a completed helicopter flight and a completed hike around 18:00–19:30. Stargaze independently instead of attending Big Sky; 21:30–23:00 remains a provisional window, not confirmed departure or return times.

alternative.title: 天气或体力不足
alternative.desc: 直升机已由用户确认完成，次晨不再候补。晚间自行观星，具体地点待定；若云多或疲惫就休息。用户已决定不参加观星团，本站未向运营方办理取消或退款。

alternativeEn.title: Weather or low energy
alternativeEn.desc: The user confirmed completing the helicopter flight; no next-morning backup is needed. Stargaze independently at a location still to be chosen, or rest if cloudy or tired. The user will not attend the guided tour; this site has not arranged cancellation or a refund with the operator.

events.text: 在已订瓦纳卡住宿吃早餐、收齐行李后退房；先复核 SH8、SH80 路况与飞行通知，水、午餐补给及保暖层放手边，08:45 出发，不为沿途拍照赶路。
events.textEn: Have breakfast at the booked Wānaka stay, pack and check out. Recheck SH8/SH80 conditions and any flight notice; keep water, food and warm layers handy. Aim to leave at 08:45 without rushing for photo stops.

events.text: 计划10:15—10:25在 Lindis Pass 有标示且可安全进入的停车处观景、伸展。停车区关闭、风大或视线差就跳过。后续驾驶另列，不计入这10分钟。
events.textEn: Plan a 10:15–10:25 viewpoint and stretch break at a signed, safely accessible Lindis Pass parking area. Skip it if access is closed, wind is strong or visibility is poor. Onward driving is listed separately.

events.text: 计划11:15—12:15在 Omarama 停车吃午餐、上洗手间并按油量补油，驾驶员坐下休息，可一并买晚餐补给。这一小时仅为停留；12:15—13:30驾驶及缓冲另列。
events.textEn: Allow 11:15–12:15 in Omarama for lunch, toilets, fuel as needed, seated driver rest and dinner supplies. This hour is a stop only; the 12:15–13:30 driving allowance is listed separately.

events.summary: 湖边短停，优先机场报到
events.text: Pukaki 只作约10分钟湖景短停，随后直接前往库克山机场，不先绕进村里；若前段耽误或停车不便就跳过，把余量留给机场停车、洗手间和报到。
events.textEn: Keep Pukaki to a roughly ten-minute lake-view stop, then head straight to Mount Cook Airport without visiting the village first. Skip the stop if delayed or parking is difficult, keeping the buffer for parking, toilets and check-in.

events.text: 用户已确认当天乘坐直升机。此处保留原机场报到计划，实际报到和起飞时刻未提供，不再安排翌日候补。
events.textEn: The user confirmed taking the helicopter flight that day. Keep the original airport check-in plan as a planning record; actual check-in and departure times were not supplied, and no next-day backup is scheduled.

events.text: 用户确认2026年10月5日已乘坐直升机。15:30—16:15沿用原估算窗口，不是已核实的实际起降时刻或飞行时长；次晨候补已取消。
events.textEn: The user confirmed taking the helicopter flight on 5 October 2026. The original estimated 15:30–16:15 window is retained, not verified actual flight times or duration. The next-morning backup has been removed.

events.summary: 先办 Motel 入住，再晚餐
events.text: 用餐与保暖准备暂留17:00—18:00计划窗口，避开用户确认的约18:00—19:30徒步；不代表实际用餐时间。住宿入住、早餐和退房信息沿用原记录。
events.textEn: Keep a provisional 17:00–18:00 window for dinner and warm layers, clear of the user-confirmed hike around 18:00–19:30. This is not a record of the actual meal time. Existing stay, breakfast and checkout details are unchanged.

events.summary: 徒步后休息与观星准备
events.summaryEn: Rest after the hike and prepare for stargazing
events.text: 徒步约19:30结束后休息、准备自行观星。19:30—21:30是计划休息窗口，并非已完成记录；不再安排观星团场次确认或集合。
events.textEn: Rest after the hike ends around 19:30 and prepare for independent stargazing. The 19:30–21:30 rest window is a plan, not a completed record. No guided-tour session check or meeting is scheduled.

events.summary: 自行观星，不参加观星团
events.summaryEn: Independent stargazing, without the guided tour
events.text: 用户决定今晚自行观星，不参加 Big Sky Stargazing。暂沿用21:30—23:00作为计划窗口，非确认的出发或结束时刻；具体观星位置未提供，不再绑定 The Hermitage 集合点。本站只更新行程，未向运营方取消预约或办理退款。
events.textEn: The user will stargaze independently tonight instead of attending Big Sky Stargazing. Retain 21:30–23:00 as a provisional planning window, not confirmed departure or finish times. No observing location was supplied, so the Hermitage meeting-point binding is removed. Only the itinerary is updated; no operator booking cancellation or refund has been processed.

events.summaryEn: A successful proposal under the stars
events.text: 用户确认先在瓦纳卡神树公园（That Wānaka Tree 附近）停车场拍了一会儿星空，然后在新西兰当地时间2026年10月5日约00:20求婚成功，之后已返回。00:20为用户回忆的近似时刻，未记录精确结束或返程时间。
events.textEn: The user confirmed photographing the stars first at the park car park near That Wānaka Tree, successfully proposing around 00:20 on 5 October 2026 in New Zealand local time, and returning afterwards. The 00:20 time is approximate as recalled by the user; the exact end and return times are not recorded.

events.text: 在原计划时段内，10:25—11:15分配给 Lindis Pass 至 Omarama 的驾驶及道路缓冲。50分钟是计划预留，不是核验过的纯驾驶时间或实时导航预计抵达时间。
events.textEn: Within the existing schedule, allocate 10:25–11:15 to driving from Lindis Pass to Omarama and road buffer. The 50 minutes is a planning allowance, not a verified driving duration or live navigation ETA.

events.text: 午餐后12:15从 Omarama 出发，至13:30的75分钟预留给前往 Lake Pukaki 的驾驶及缓冲，不包含已另列的午餐。沿用原到达目标，不代表实时路况下的准确车程。
events.textEn: After lunch, allocate 12:15–13:30 to driving from Omarama to Lake Pukaki and buffer, excluding the separately listed lunch. This preserves the original arrival target, not an exact drive time under live road conditions.

events.summaryEn: Drive to the airport; allow 35 minutes
events.text: Pukaki短停后13:40出发，14:15机场到达目标保持不变；35分钟为驾驶及缓冲的计划分配，不是实时导航车程。若此前延误，缩短或取消湖景停留，不赶路。
events.textEn: Leave after the Pukaki stop at 13:40, keeping the original 14:15 airport arrival target. The 35 minutes is a driving and buffer allocation, not a live navigation duration. If delayed, shorten or skip the lake stop without rushing.

events.text: 用户确认2026年10月5日约18:00出发徒步、约19:30结束。具体步道与精确起止时间尚未提供；记录为已完成的约90分钟区间。直升机完成状态另由用户确认。
events.textEn: The user confirmed starting a hike around 18:00 and finishing around 19:30 on 5 October 2026. The specific trail and exact times were not supplied. Record an approximately 90-minute completed interval. Completion of the helicopter flight was separately confirmed by the user.

days.highlight: 10:00酒店早餐完成，退房装车后10:15出发；驾车、游览、午餐与休息分段安排，13:00离开蒂卡波，计划15:45到奥马鲁。企鹅晚场仍待订。
days.highlightEn: Finish hotel breakfast at 10:00, then check out, load the car and leave at 10:15. Driving, sightseeing, meals and rest have separate blocks: leave Tekapo at 13:00 and plan to reach Ōamaru at 15:45. The penguin evening is still unbooked.

alternative.title: 延误时减少游览，不压缩休息
alternative.desc: 直升机已完成，不再安排候补。道路延误时缩短蒂卡波游览、取消港边散步，保留用餐与驾驶员休息；企鹅未订妥则先问官方当日选项，不把路边等候当替代晚场。

alternativeEn.title: Reduce sightseeing if delayed, not rest
alternativeEn.desc: The helicopter flight is complete and no backup is scheduled. If delayed, shorten Tekapo sightseeing and skip the harbour walk while keeping meals and driver rest. If penguins remain unbooked, check official same-day options rather than treating roadside waiting as an alternative.

events.text: 09:00—10:00预留酒店早餐，不再安排直升机候补；早餐具体供应安排沿用住宿确认资料。
events.textEn: Allow 09:00–10:00 for hotel breakfast, without a helicopter backup. Refer to the existing stay confirmation for breakfast arrangements.

events.text: 10:00为早餐完成的计划时点，不再表示最晚离开库克山；随后退房、装车另列。
events.textEn: 10:00 is the planned breakfast-finished milestone, not a latest departure from Mount Cook. Checkout and loading are listed separately.

events.summary: 驾车至蒂卡波，预留90分钟
events.text: 10:15—11:45安排从库克山至蒂卡波的驾驶及缓冲，不包含游览和午餐。90分钟是行程预留，并非实时导航车程；出发前核对SH80、SH8路况。
events.textEn: Allocate 10:15–11:45 to driving from Mount Cook to Tekapo and buffer, excluding sightseeing and lunch. The 90 minutes is a planning allowance, not a live navigation duration; check SH80 and SH8 conditions before leaving.

events.text: 13:00—14:00预留蒂卡波至 Omarama 的驾驶及缓冲，后续15分钟休息单独安排。不把预留时间当作核验过的纯驾驶耗时。
events.textEn: Allow 13:00–14:00 for driving from Tekapo to Omarama and buffer, with a separate 15-minute break afterwards. This is a planning allowance, not a verified drive duration.

events.text: 15:45—16:15计划到达已订奥马鲁住宿、停车、入住及卸行李，按私下保存的指示办理；实际入住条件以住宿确认为准，休息另列。
events.textEn: Plan 15:45–16:15 for arrival at the booked Ōamaru stay, parking, check-in and unloading using privately held instructions. Actual access follows the stay confirmation; rest is listed separately.

events.text: 有体力才从已入住的住宿去港边短走，遇海狗保持至少20米，不喂、不摸、不挡通海路线；看不到就不追找。风大、疲倦或到得晚，整段改回房休息。
events.textEn: Only go for a short harbour walk after check-in if you have energy. Keep at least 20 metres from seals, do not feed or touch them, and keep their route to the sea clear. Do not chase sightings; rest instead if windy, tired or late.

events.text: 18:00—19:00只安排奥马鲁晚餐、洗手间和保暖准备；前往企鹅保护区的驾驶和停车另列。
events.textEn: Reserve 18:00–19:00 for dinner in Ōamaru, toilets and warm layers only. Driving to the penguin colony and parking are listed separately.

events.text: 19:30—20:00是围绕原20:00参考场次的报到候场计划，须先取得有效确认并按票面调整。驾驶停车已另列；沿用现有晚场记录，收好相机和手机，不拍照、不录像、不亮屏，规则仍须复核。
events.textEn: 19:30–20:00 is a check-in and waiting plan around the existing 20:00 reference session, subject to valid booking confirmation and ticket instructions. Driving and parking are separate. Under the existing evening record, put cameras and phones away without photos, filming or bright screens; recheck the current rules.

events.summary: 企鹅晚场，场次余位待核
events.summaryEn: Penguin evening; session still to verify
events.text: 企鹅晚场仍待预订，20:00仅作计划参考，须核对10/6实际场次和两人余位；原价格为7/29旧核验，不作当前报价。订妥后安静就座，实际结束时间待核，不追21:30时点。
events.textEn: The penguin evening is still unbooked; verify the 6 October session and availability for two rather than treating 20:00 as confirmed. The original prices were checked on 29 July and are not current quotes. Sit quietly once booked; the finish time is unverified, not fixed at 21:30.

events.summaryEn: Drive back to the stay after viewing
events.text: 21:30—22:00为离场后返回奥马鲁住宿的计划驾驶及缓冲，不是确认的散场或车程；按工作人员安排离场，停车区和港边慢行留意野生动物，不为时间点赶路。
events.textEn: 21:30–22:00 is a planning allowance for driving back to the Ōamaru stay after viewing, not confirmed finish or drive times. Leave as directed by staff and drive slowly around the car park and harbour, watching for wildlife without rushing.

events.summaryEn: Check out and load the car
events.text: 10:00早餐完成后，预留15分钟退房、装车；10:15是计划出发时刻，不代表酒店允许的最晚退房，实际按住宿确认办理。
events.textEn: After finishing breakfast at 10:00, allow 15 minutes for checkout and loading. The 10:15 departure is a plan, not the hotel's checkout deadline; follow the stay confirmation.

events.text: 11:45—12:15只安排好牧羊人教堂外观和蒂卡波湖边，约30分钟。内部开放未核实，不作为必去项；驾驶和午餐分别列出。
events.textEn: Allow 11:45–12:15 for the Church of the Good Shepherd exterior and Tekapo lakefront only. Interior access is unverified and not essential; driving and lunch are separate.

events.text: 12:15—13:00预留45分钟午餐和洗手间，不含驾驶；13:00计划出发往 Omarama。餐厅和预约未指定。
events.textEn: Allow 12:15–13:00 for lunch and toilets, excluding driving, before the planned 13:00 departure towards Omarama. No restaurant or reservation has been specified.

events.text: 14:00—14:15在 Omarama 合法停车，上洗手间、伸展并让驾驶员休息；这是独立停留，不含下一段驾驶。
events.textEn: Plan a 14:00–14:15 stop in a legal parking place in Omarama for toilets, stretching and driver rest, excluding the next driving leg.

events.summary: 驾车至奥马鲁，预留90分钟
events.text: 14:15—15:45安排 Omarama 至已订奥马鲁住宿的驾驶及缓冲；15:45只作计划到达。延误就减少后续游览，不压缩休息或赶路。
events.textEn: Allocate 14:15–15:45 to driving from Omarama to the booked Ōamaru stay and buffer. The 15:45 arrival is a plan; reduce later sightseeing if delayed rather than rushing or cutting rest.

events.text: 16:15—16:45入住后坐下休息，并核对企鹅是否订妥及实际场次；体力不足时继续休息，港边散步可取消。
events.textEn: Rest after check-in from 16:15–16:45 and check the penguin booking and actual session. Keep resting and skip the harbour walk if tired.

events.summary: 前往企鹅保护区与停车
events.summaryEn: Drive to the penguin colony and park
events.text: 19:00—19:30预留前往企鹅保护区及停车的时间，不是纯驾驶预计耗时。19:30报到仍须按最终票面调整，不假定已预订。
events.textEn: Allow 19:00–19:30 to reach the penguin colony and park, not as a pure driving estimate. The planned 19:30 check-in must follow the eventual ticket; no booking is assumed.

events.text: 16:45—17:00预留从奥马鲁住宿到港边及停车；实际车程取决于住宿位置，不把15分钟作为核验导航时间。若取消港边散步，这段一并取消。
events.textEn: Allow 16:45–17:00 to reach the harbour from the Ōamaru stay and park. Actual driving depends on the stay location; 15 minutes is not a verified navigation duration. Skip this transfer if skipping the harbour walk.

days.highlight: 北上分两次休息，15:00后入住；傍晚只走一小圈，为次日11:00机场还车留精神。
days.highlightEn: Take two breaks northbound and check in after 15:00. Keep the evening walk short before tomorrow's 11:00 airport car return.

alternative.title: 雨天或长途后疲倦
alternative.desc: 抵达后先入住，雨大或疲倦就取消河边和街区散步，保留就近晚餐即可；不新增远途景点。道路延误时通知住宿并缩短游览，不牺牲驾驶员休息。

alternativeEn.title: Rain or tired after the drive
alternativeEn.desc: Check in first. In heavy rain or if tired, skip the river and street walks and keep only a nearby dinner without adding distant sights. If road delays occur, notify the stay and shorten sightseeing rather than driver breaks.

links: 基督城市议会停车地图入口

events.text: 在已订奥马鲁住宿吃早餐、收齐行李，09:30退房并沿北上主路往 Timaru；先复核 SH1 路况。若前晚睡得晚，删减到城后散步，不用压缩途中休息来追赶。
events.textEn: Have breakfast and pack at the booked Ōamaru stay, check out at 09:30 and head north towards Timaru after checking SH1. If the previous night ran late, reduce the city walk rather than cutting driver breaks.

events.text: 在 Timaru 合法停车，约15—20分钟喝咖啡、上洗手间和伸展；风雨时只作室内短休，不另找海边点位。休息后继续北上，此时间块包含到 Ashburton 的行车。
events.textEn: Park legally in Timaru for a 15–20 minute coffee, toilet and stretch break. In wind or rain, keep it indoors without seeking another waterfront stop. Continue north afterwards; this block includes the drive to Ashburton.

events.summary: 午餐休息后开往基督城
events.text: 在 Ashburton 停车吃午餐，让驾驶员离开驾驶座休息；按油量补油后继续往基督城。不要把此段全算成午餐，也不压缩休息去赶14:30预计到达时间。
events.textEn: Park in Ashburton for lunch and give the driver a break away from the wheel. Refuel as needed before continuing to Christchurch. This is not all lunch time, and breaks should not be cut to meet the estimated 14:30 arrival.

events.text: 14:30只作预计到达；已订基督城房源15:00后才能按确认办理入住。先核对私下停车和入户指示，早到则在合法车位休息等候，不假定可提前入住或寄存行李。
events.textEn: 14:30 is only an estimated arrival; the booked Christchurch stay allows check-in from 15:00. Follow privately held parking and access instructions. If early, wait in a legal parking place without assuming early entry or luggage storage.

events.text: 入住卸行李后，以 Riverside Market 为一个短停点，按现场营业情况喝咖啡或简单逛，再沿雅芳河走一小段；雨大就取消河边段。尽量一次停车，离车前核对收费和允许停放时长。
events.textEn: After checking in and unloading, make a short Riverside Market stop for coffee or browsing if trading, then take a brief Avon River walk. Skip the riverside in heavy rain. Prefer one parking stop and check charges and time limits before leaving the car.

events.summaryEn: A short square and street walk
events.text: 有余力再把 Cathedral Square 外观与 New Regent Street 串成短走，不默认教堂或商店仍可进入；遇施工围挡按现场指示绕行。累了就跳过其中一处，提前去晚餐。
events.textEn: If you still have energy, link an exterior look at Cathedral Square with a short New Regent Street stroll. Do not assume church or shop entry; follow any signed construction diversions. Skip one stop and eat early if tired.

events.summary: 晚餐回房，准备翌日还车
events.summaryEn: Dinner and prepare for car return
events.text: 在当前街区就近吃晚餐，不为餐厅再开车绕城；饭后回已订住宿整理行李，私下核对次日11:00机场还车及航班资料、加油要求和出发路线，今晚留足睡眠。
events.textEn: Have dinner in the area rather than driving across town for a restaurant. Return to the booked stay to pack and privately check tomorrow's 11:00 airport car return, flight details, fuel requirements and departure route. Leave enough time for sleep.
